profile.name: Angela Agunwami *Onwuka*
profile.tagline: Founder, technologist and content creator. I build businesses, explore artificial intelligence, and share the life in between.

about.heading: Two homes, one long journey
about.lead: I was born and raised in Nigeria and moved to the United States at thirteen. Both places shaped who I am, and both show up in everything I build.
paragraphs: My background sits where technology and business meet. I've spent my career turning what people need into systems that work, and I'm always learning, lately with a focus on artificial intelligence.
In 2022 I founded Agunwami Enterprises, where I lead a team building digital products for the US and Nigeria.
Being a founder is a big part of my life, but it isn't all of it. This site is the rest: what I'm learning, what I'm making, and what I'm figuring out along the way.
